appraisal_events.evidence: M. de Châtellerault était aussi froussard qu'imprudent; il s'était borné à se faire passer pour un Anglais, et... répondre... « I do not speak french »
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator directly characterizes Châtellerault as cowardly, exposing how he disavows and coldly rebuffs the doorman who had granted him favors rather than risk his incognito being broken.

appraisal_events.evidence: on jugeait généralement l'esprit d'initiative et la supériorité intellectuelle de cette dame... mettre en relief avec quel naturel « une grande dame sait recevoir »... ce visage... était frappé comme une si belle médaille
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator elevates the princesse as a uniquely skilled, admired hostess and strikingly beautiful, majestic figure, while gently exposing the calculated, self-serving machinery behind her apparently natural grace.

status_effects.explanation: He comes off worse locally because the narrator exposes his cowardice and his ungrateful disavowal of the doorman who had shown him favor.
Society is shown explicitly registering her intelligence and social mastery through an innovation unmatched elsewhere in her milieu.
The narrator personally admires her striking, near-royal beauty and bearing, though this praise is lightly qualified by irony about the calculated nature of her graciousness.
